voxel.inference: Repeated callback preparation is a larger demonstrated consumer job; bridge scopes alone do not establish a CPU saving or an A/B win.

decision: Defer a standalone immutable-view/compatibility-copy rewrite. Prefer one prepared consumer render job (NES11), because full world/voxel preparation is repeated at frame-end and present while the bridge itself is a small measured scope. This is prioritization based on real gameplay attribution, not a gain floor, idle-host requirement or behavior constraint. No optimization has been implemented or speedup measured for NES15.
next: After fresh independent validation and durable Beads record, NES11 is the next proposed serial candidate. A measured full render job may subsume compatibility work; revisit NES15 only when that changes the evidence.
scope_correction: NES15 means cyc_presentation_sync legacy OAM/nametable/palette/CHR snapshots. Full HdPixel expansion is a separate NES13 follow-up; the preceding NES13 narrative incorrectly tied that expansion to NES15. The register itself retained the correct definition.
exclusions: The initial diagnostic attempt omitted --mods-root for headless preparation. HD state then failed program identity against the correctly patched window build. Entire first attempt excluded; corrected run passes explicit mods root on both paths and prepares each profile independently. Optional --present-out did not produce a final window PNG; no final screenshot claim is made.

validator.decision: independently validated measured deferral; no runtime PR warranted
